outcome:
## Bugs (found in v3.0.1)

All LLM-backed `quorum compass` subcommands (`brief`, `pathways`, `bets`, `score`, `spec`) threw at runtime because two async calls were missing `await`:

```js
// BEFORE (broken)
const chronicleDir = findChronicleDir(rootDir)   // Promise<string> not string
const llm = ... detectProvider()                  // {llm,name} object not the callable fn
```

`findChronicleDir` is async (returns `Promise<string|null>`), so without `await` it became a `Promise` object — `path.
